entities.summary: Johannes Itten was a Swiss expressionist painter, designer, teacher, writer and theorist associated with the Bauhaus school. Together with German-American painter Lyonel Feininger and German sculptor Gerhard Marcks, under the direction of German architect Walter Gropius, Itten was part of the core of the Weimar Bauhaus. Johannes Itten was a architects & engineers from Wachseldorn (1888-11-11, Wachseldorn–1967-03-25). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
